title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Numbers 19: the red heifer, the water for impurity and the cleansing of those who touched the dead.

questions.text: What kind of heifer were the children of Israel to bring?
questions.explanation: They were to bring a red heifer without spot, with no defect, which was never yoked.

answers.text: A white heifer that had borne a calf
A black heifer from the flock of Levi
A spotted heifer that had been yoked once
A red heifer without spot that was never yoked

questions.text: To which priest was the heifer to be given?
questions.explanation: The heifer was to be given to Eleazar the priest, who would bring her outside the camp.

questions.text: How many times was the heifer's blood to be sprinkled toward the front of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Eleazar was to take some of her blood with his finger and sprinkle it toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

questions.text: What did the priest cast into the middle of the burning heifer?
questions.explanation: The priest was to take cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

questions.text: Where were the ashes of the heifer to be laid up?
questions.explanation: A clean man was to gather the ashes and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place.

answers.text: Outside the camp in a clean place
In the tent of the high priest

questions.text: On which days was someone who touched a dead body to purify himself with water?
questions.explanation: He was to purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he would be clean.

answers.text: Only on the first day after touching it
On the second day and on the eighth day
Every day for a whole month
On the third day and on the seventh day

questions.text: What would happen to someone who touched a dead person and did not purify himself?
questions.explanation: He defiled Yahweh's tabernacle, and that soul was to be cut off from Israel.

answers.text: He would be cut off from Israel
He would be clean after one day
He would be made a servant of the Levites

questions.text: When a man died in a tent, which vessels were unclean?
questions.explanation: Every open vessel which had no covering bound on it was unclean.

answers.text: Only the vessels made of gold and silver
Every open vessel with no covering bound on it
Only the empty clay vessels in the tent
No vessels at all, only the people

questions.text: What was poured on the ashes in a vessel to make the water for the unclean?
questions.explanation: For the unclean they were to take of the ashes of the sin offering, and running water was poured on them in a vessel.

questions.text: What does the chapter say about whatever an unclean person touches?
questions.explanation: Whatever the unclean person touches is unclean, and the soul that touches it is unclean until evening.

answers.text: It must be given to the priest
